$comment: Seeds that deviate from a contract TODAY, each with the reason. The validator tolerates exactly these and reports them on every run, so a defect stays visible and can never be copied into new content. To retire one, fix the seed and delete the entry; a stale entry (the seed now conforms) FAILS validation. Do not add an entry for new content: new content must pass. 'kind' is missing-property (itemId + field) or empty-field (every item in the file, or one itemId).
